Name: Four Acres Farm
Author: pluviophist
Description:
[font=Times New Roman]Welcome to Four Acres! This map features 4 vast, personalized and unique spaces, intended (but not required!) for 4+ multiplayer. If you're someone who likes to play with friends, but prefers split funds/having your own space, this map is made for you.[/font]

[font=Times New Roman]Features designated farming plots with sprinkler spots, tillable grass, enclosed animal pens, a quarry, regenerating stumps, river fish, 3 different minecart spots [[/font][i]you must complete the minecart bundle![/i][font=Times New Roman]], and both forest and beach forageables. Each player section also includes an outdoor spa for regenerating health and energy! [/font]

[font=Times New Roman]The plaza next to the greenhouse acts as a communal area. Share furnaces, chests, or just decorate it! [/font]

[font=Times New Roman][I know the river flow doesn't make a lot of sense, but let's just pretend it does...] [/font]
[line]

[b]There are two download options: A four corners replacement, or a new farm type. Only download one. [/b][font=Times New Roman]A huge thank you to [/font][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194501065-bambookatt/][font=Times New Roman]BambooKatt [/font][/url][font=Times New Roman]for converting the farm type, which saved me tons of time. [/font][font=Times New Roman](˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶)[/font]

[font=Times New Roman]I used Roseora's [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24686?tab=posts]Very large meadowlands farm map[/url][font=Times New Roman] as a base for making this map, and [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]crystalinerose's Tilesheets[/url][font=Times New Roman] [required!]. Make sure to show them lots of support![/font]
[line]

[size=5][font=Courier New][size=4]✿[b] Installation[/b][/size][/font][/size]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]Crystalinerose's Tilesheets[/url]﻿.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Download this mod. [b]Only download one version[/b], the Four Corners replacer or the new farm type.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley "Mods/" folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Run the game using SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Times New Roman]
[size=4]✿ [/size][font=Times New Roman][size=3][b]Enjoy the map, and please let me know if you come across any issues.[/b][/size][size=4] [/size][/font] ʕ •ᴥ•ʔ ♡[/font]
[b]
To uninstall, delete this mod from Mods folder.

[/b][font=Courier New][size=4][b]Mods Used in Screenshots[/b][/size][/font]
[font=Times New Roman]Map/Foliage Recolor: [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url][font=Times New Roman] [ + VPR Expanded in optional files ], [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Stardew Foliage Redone[/url]
[font=Times New Roman]Buildings: [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Gwen's medieval buildings[/url][font=Times New Roman] and [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27579]Italian Countryside Buildings[/url][font=Times New Roman] [[/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27005]Italian Countryside Farmhouse[/url][font=Times New Roman]][/font]
[font=Times New Roman]Craftables: [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13897]Gwen's Craftables for AT[/url][font=Times New Roman] [VPR version], [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16935]Nano's Garden Style Craftables[/url][font=Times New Roman], [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24980]Modular Planters[/url][font=Times New Roman], [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20973]Shyzie's String Lights[/url][font=Times New Roman] [/font]
[font=Times New Roman]﻿Reshade: [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color[/url]
